failure_summary.description: Agents imported a nonexistent tools module instead of calling injected functions directly.
Agents skipped or mishandled updates to cached results, including using the wrong operation or returning a no-op.
Agents missed that available trip details supported independent searches while another domain needed clarification.
An agent requested a city even though the tool supports searching by the supplied state.
An agent inferred a traveler count from a family description and passed it as an optional argument.

patch.reasoning: The dominant failures—tool imports, cached-result updates, independent searches, and state-level attraction searches—are already explicitly addressed by the skill. Repeating those rules would not patch a gap; the remaining optional-count inference is isolated in this batch.
